intended_object: The set of compatible families of prime ideals (p_j ∈ Spec F(j)) for a diagram F of commutative rings, meaning families with F(f)^{-1}(p_k) = p_j for every f : j → k. This is the set-theoretic inverse limit lim_j Spec F(j) of the underlying sets of the spectra. Inferred from the docstring and from how the file uses it to show that the spectrum of a filtered colimit is the limit of the spectra.
explanation:
The body is `Functor.sections` of the composite J^op → TopCat → Type, which sends j to the underlying set of Spec F(j). An element is a family `s.val (op j) : PrimeSpectrum (F.obj j)` such that for each f : i → j the induced map Spec F(j) → Spec F(i), i.e. `comap (F.map f)`, sends s_j to s_i. That is exactly a compatible tuple of prime ideals, as `section_mem_map` in the same file confirms.

The definition takes any small category J and any diagram of commutative rings, with no filteredness assumption. The universe level `max v u` only lets the comparison limit exist and does not narrow the mathematics. The definition is a thin abbreviation of Mathlib's general `Functor.sections`, specialised to this functor, so it adds no special-case content. It matches its docstring.
